items.what: The server view getter must accept a keyword parameter named exactly `sort_by` (the instruction only says 'pick a field to sort by' in the App, never naming the API parameter).
The view getter must accept a keyword parameter named exactly `desc` to request descending sort (mapped to `reverse=True`); the instruction never names it.
The produced sort stage must serialize with kwarg names `field_or_expr` and `reverse`, and include `create_index` set to False in exactly that order.

reason: The instruction describes only App-level behavior; the hidden test exercises server-side API parameters `sort_by`/`desc` and the serialized kwarg names, of which only `create_index: False` is guessable from the no-indexes requirement — the parameter names themselves are not stated.
